body: Druski opens up about how a call from Drake @champagnepapi changed his life: “The thing that changed my life was Drake calling for The Laugh Now Cry Later music video. Brands started to take me seriously, it was no more sending free merch. It wasn’t until then that the real money was coming in. I can’t believe he took a chance on me” steven.

Druski opens up about how a call from Drake changed his life: 

“The thing that changed my life was Drake calling for The Laugh Now Cry Later music video. Brands started to take me seriously, it was no more sending free merch.
